additional_info.subject: Notes from RC
additional_info.body:
Issue with charger stuck at payment pending.
[UPT1000F_Castles_SEITATECH]: Command Get terminal status finished with error: Transaction pending.
I have checked with Jyri at seitatech and he doesn't see any errors on his side.
If I reboot the charger, it will work again but as soon as someone has charged it will get this error again. See attached movie to see how it looks on the charger HMI.

additional_info.subject: Notes for L2 & L3
additional_info.body:
The issue appears to be that the terminal does not consistently "wake up" when customers press on the charger screen to pay with a credit card. Often, when someone selects the credit card option on the screen, the terminal does not respond, resulting in a failed message being displayed.
The issue I'm facing is that no errors are apparent from the charger's side. However, the same message appears repeatedly in the logs.
